inputs: Canonical records from Company OS subsystem stores under a caller-supplied state directory
Canonical bootstrap permissions, organization registry and capsule graph
invariants: The dashboard is a read model: it changes no canonical record and exposes no approval, spend, hire, publish or merge action.
Unknown and stale evidence remain explicit; an empty subsystem is never reported as zero or healthy.
Every executive item retains compact source references and fingerprints, never a copied canonical record body.
No global company, format or project verdict is computed; independent dimensions stay independent.
Decision ordering is blocked, deadline, reserved action, risk, created date and id - never an opaque priority value.
Snapshot IDs, canonical JSON, briefs and structured diffs are deterministic for the same inputs and as-of date.
outputs: Canonical JSON CompanyStateSnapshot with source, freshness, missing-data and integrity references
Compact CEOBrief, deterministic decision queue, attention items and structured snapshot diff
purpose: Compresses canonical Company OS state into a deterministic, read-only executive snapshot and brief without approving, ranking or operating the company.
risks: A source subsystem may be absent or incomplete; the view reports that gap and does not infer health.
Derived totals are summaries of supplied records, not a replacement for subsystem-owned calculations.
title: CEO company-state dashboard
